screen.uncrafteverything.config.allow_da: Allow Damaged Items to be Uncrafted (Reapair Item will be deducted)

tooltip.uncrafteverything.config.toggle_: Toggle Restriction Type
tooltip.uncrafteverything.config.blackli: All items defined in Restricted Items will not be able to uncraft
tooltip.uncrafteverything.config.whiteli: Only items defined in Restricted Items will be able to uncraft
tooltip.uncrafteverything.config.edit_re: The value can be either item id, item tags, or item id wildcard, separate each entry with new line
tooltip.uncrafteverything.config.toggle_: Toggle Allow Enchanted Items
tooltip.uncrafteverything.config.allow_e: Enchanted Item can be uncrafted, enchanted book will be given (A bit cheating, not recommended to enable)
Enchanted Item cannot uncrafted (Recommended to enable to prevent getting enchanted book easier than it should)
tooltip.uncrafteverything.config.toggle_: Toggle Experience Type
tooltip.uncrafteverything.config.point_i: Sufficient experience point will be required to uncraft, and will be consumed on each uncraft
tooltip.uncrafteverything.config.level_i: Sufficient experience level will be required to uncraft, and will be consumed on each uncraft
tooltip.uncrafteverything.config.edit_ex: Experience point/level to be consumed when uncrafting. For setting different experience amount for certain items, please go to Per Item Exp Config
tooltip.uncrafteverything.config.toggle_: Toggle Allow Unsmithing
Netherite/Trimmed tools & armor will be able to uncraft, same for custom smithing recipe from other mods
Items obtained from smithing will not be able to uncraft
Toggle Allow Damaged Items
Damaged items will be able to uncraft, but the material will be deducted based on durability
Damaged items will not be able to uncraft
Toggle Prevent Modded Ingredients
Ingredients/Items that are not vanilla will not be searched when uncrafting vanilla items
Every ingredients will be included when uncrafting vanilla item (Not recommended, possible duplication)
tooltip.uncrafteverything.config.edit_re: A list of mod id that their ingredients will be restricted when uncrafting, this apply to every items (Enter each mod id in a new line)
tooltip.uncrafteverything.config.toggle_: Toggle Enable Progression

Item defined in Progression Config will be locked from uncrafting until the quest is done (Item that are not defined in config might also disabled depending on the config below), FTB Quests are required for this to work
Nothing happen, uncrafting table work as usual
Toggle Only Allow Defined Progression
This config value only work when progression is enabled
Item that are not defined in Progression Config will never be able to uncraft
Everything will be able to uncraft except the item that are defined with a quest that is not completed
Toggle Output Enchanted Book
Toggle if uncrafting enchanted item should output enchanted book
Enchanted book will be outputted when uncrafting enchanted item
Enchanted book will not be outputted when uncrafting enchanted item
tooltip.uncrafteverything.config.auto_mo: Auto move item from output slot to player inventory when uncrafted, if player inventory full item will be dropped
Uncrafted item stay in output slot as usual
screen.uncrafteverything.tooltip.client_: to change status color and other client config (Client side only)
screen.uncrafteverything.tooltip.common_: to access common config to modify uncrafting recipe searching behaviour (Server side only, OP level 4 required)
screen.uncrafteverything.tooltip.exp_con: to access per item exp config to modify exp needed for specific items (Server side only, OP level 4 required)
screen.uncrafteverything.tooltip.progres: to access ftb progression config to modify progression uncrafting (Server side only, OP level 4 required)
screen.uncrafteverything.tooltip.level_d: Levels are converted to XP points using vanilla formula to prevent exploits or XP loss
1 level = varying XP depending on current level
Higher levels = more XP points transferred
